lints.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
lints.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
lints.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.detail: Table \`lifecity_private.prayer_day_rewards\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.city_visit(p_code text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/city_visit`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.world_surprise_visit(p_token text)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/world_surprise_visit`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.city_visit(p_code text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/city_visit`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.game_command(p_action text, p_payload jsonb, p_key uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/game_command`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.world_read_history(p_id uuid)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/world_read_history`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.world_surprise_visit(p_token text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/world_surprise_visit`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
lints.title: Leaked Password Protection Disabled
lints.description: Leaked password protection is currently disabled.

findings.detail: Supabase Auth prevents the use of compromised passwords by checking against HaveIBeenPwned.org. Enable this feature to enhance security.

assessment: New reward table is private, RLS-enabled and fully revoked without policies. That adds one intentional deny-all INFO finding; pre-existing RPC and Auth warnings are unchanged. No historical data backfill or cost rewrite.
